entries.d5080a6d4509dcd9: This business manufactures and sells automotive interior parts, including trunk trim, floor trim, seat parts and roof parts. The company manufactures and sells in Japan, and Meiwa (Dalian) Qiche Peijian Youxian Gongsi, Meiwa (Foshan) Qiche Peijian Youxian Gongsi, MEIWA INDUSTRY NORTH AMERICA,INC. and MEIWA INDUSTRY (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. manufacture and sell overseas; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,971 million.
entries.dcda8daf610d7abf: MEIWA INDUSTRY CO.,LTD. has its head office in Atsugi, Kanagawa Prefecture, and together with four consolidated subsidiaries and one non-consolidated subsidiary constitutes the group. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 372.
entries.ddfb33b43374a1bf: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 0.8% year on year to ¥23,065 million. Automotive parts accounted for 90.9% of net sales, followed by housing at 9.0%.
entries.df0655bb1f829d7b: The share of the Toyota Motor Group in consolidated net sales is disclosed as 57.5%, and supplying interior parts to Japanese automobile manufacturers is the core of the business. Among major customers, Toyota Boshoku Corporation accounts for 15.3% of net sales and Hayashi Telempu Corporation for 11.8%.
entries.eb9ea156a34cd542: Based on resin compounding and processing technology cultivated since its founding in 1956, it supplies automotive interior parts from production bases in the four regions of Japan, China, North America and ASEAN.
entries.f406ed56ebefb4ef: Looking ahead to 2035, under a long-term vision, it is addressing three key priorities in its medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years from the fiscal year ended March 2025 to the fiscal year ending March 2031: strengthening earnings capacity, growth strategy and ESG management.
